title: spec/objectql: the SharedRecordIds and seam docblocks still describe the share-grant list in the present tense after the switch
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyXo4gSy8DJPNz4ANz

Filing gate: ③ stale prose the contract review named · Source: fleet (L2 record 7064569198 on #36116, N3; seat 7's call, 2026-11-21 15:04 UTC). Part of #33787.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：第 6 步切换后，`packages/spec/src/data/shared-record-ids.ts` 和 `packages/objectql/src/fixed-read-leaf-seam.ts` 的注释仍用现在时描述「最多 5000 条的 id 名单」。
- 这一步做什么：把这两处注释改成切换后的说法（名单已退役，读取走子查询）。纯注释。
- 不做会怎样：读注释的人（和 AI）会以为上限还在。
- 要你做的：无。

## Scope
- Docblock prose only, in the two files named and any other docblock that `git grep -n "5,000\|5000" -- packages/spec/src/data packages/objectql/src` finds about the grant list. A comment-only `zod.ts` edit still ships bytes, so it needs a patch changeset (the standing note in project memory).
- After #36116 merges.

## Dedupe
`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue SharedRecordIds docblock present tense` → none.

Grade: p3. Type: Task.
